sections.title: Methods
sections.markdown:
The test is rolling origin expanding forecasting of organic daily successful actions (Intents-generated accounts excluded), log1p scale, with horizons of 1, 7, 14 days and a minimum training length of 60 days. [results/preregistration.json#/split/method][results/hypothesis.json#/primaryOutcome][results/estimates.json#/byHorizonCandidate/1:intents/horizon][results/estimates.json#/byHorizonCandidate/7:intents/horizon][results/estimates.json#/byHorizonCandidate/14:intents/horizon][results/preregistration.json#/split/minTrain]

Models: standardised ridge, alpha=1.0, scaler fit on training rows per origin. Candidates add lagged Intents volume, lagged price returns, or both to the baseline of usage and calendar history. [results/models.json#/estimator]

Uncertainty: a moving-block bootstrap with block length 7 and 500 resamples gives the 95% intervals; Benjamini-Hochberg control at q 0.0500 is applied across the frozen family of 9 comparisons; the last 30 days form a sealed lockbox; the random seed is 20261111. [results/preregistration.json#/thresholds/bootstrap/block][results/preregistration.json#/thresholds/bootstrap/n][results/preregistration.json#/thresholds/bootstrap/level][results/preregistration.json#/fdr/method][results/preregistration.json#/fdr/q][results/estimates.json#/fdr/m][results/preregistration.json#/split/lockboxDays][results/preregistration.json#/randomSeed]

The claim is predictive only. Causality is excluded from the claim, and a forecasting gain would not show that Intents volume moves usage. Every sentence in this document is produced by a deterministic template from the frozen files; no language model writes any number.

sections.title: Confounders and blind spots
sections.markdown:
- Predictive (Granger-style) evidence only; causality is excluded from the claim. [results/limitations.json#/0]
- Private/confidential Intents execution after the 2026-10-27 regime is unobserved, not zero. [results/limitations.json#/1]
- Post-regime window is analysed separately and has 15 usable rows. [results/limitations.json#/2]
- Models are ridge regressions on log1p-scale features; no nonlinear model class is claimed. [results/limitations.json#/3]
- source_coverage reports non-complete states: [{"dataset": "intents_swaps", "days": 1, "first_day": "2026-07-23", "last_day": "2026-07-23", "state": "partial"}] [results/limitations.json#/4]
- post-hoc registration: frozen fixture-evaluation parameters applied unchanged; the live-organic-v3 study rules were registered before the run (document sha256:bc906a6bbf4901b553f1773716cc3714364b9e8b64b71842b534d087bf520e4b, frozen 2026-11-12T11:55:08.000Z) but no chain commitment exists, so the engine label is unchanged [results/limitations.json#/5]
- COMPUTED (live-organic-v3, canonical asset registry): stablecoin and non-stablecoin route cells are descriptive robustness rows in robustness_matrix.json and do not enter the verdict; 7841 of 3990299 swaps are unmapped and excluded, not guessed [results/limitations.json#/6]
- Statistical significance is not claimed for 9 of 9 comparisons: every candidate model contains the baseline (nested), so Diebold-Mariano inference is not valid under the null, and the fixed-m method's calibration status is attached to each comparison (amendment 002, post_hoc_methodological_correction). [results/limitations.json#/7]
- Price, Intents swaps and network usage can all respond to the same market conditions, so co-movement between them is not evidence that one leads another.
- Accounts that belong to Intents infrastructure are excluded from the forecast target by a fixed rule; usage by automated accounts that are not on that list is still counted.
- The chart window (2026-05-05 to 2026-11-11) and the research window (2026-05-05 to 2026-11-11) are the same; the daily series come from different systems (see the dataset table), so a day can be partial in one and complete in another. sections.title: Long-term economic mechanisms
sections.markdown:
Interpretation, not a result: nothing in this section is computed from the frozen files, and none of it is a claim of the thesis.
- Cross-chain swaps could bring new accounts onto the network and create demand for contract calls, storage and fees; the data here do not show whether they do.
- Swap volume could mostly reflect traders moving existing balances through solvers, which would add transactions without adding new usage.
- Token price could reflect speculation and wider market mood more than product usage, which would weaken price as a gauge of usage in either direction.
- Fee-sensitive or incentive-driven flows can fade when incentives change, so a rise in volume over a short window says little about how long it lasts.
- Any mechanism would need its own preregistered test with account-level data before it could be stated as evidence.

sections.title: Reproduction
sections.markdown:
From the repository root `nearesis-app`:
- `pnpm thesis:build` rebuilds THESIS.md, the static dashboard, thesis.json and HASHES.json offline from thesis/raw and the frozen research results.
- `pnpm thesis:verify` rebuilds into a temporary directory and compares every hash with thesis/build/HASHES.json; it exits with an error if any file differs.
- `pnpm thesis:data` re-freezes thesis/raw from the local stores (the only step that needs the databases).
The research results come from the run recorded by: `cd nearesis-app && PYTHONPATH=services/research uv run python -m nearesis_research.cli live --snapshot docs/research/live-snapshots/live-20260505-20261111-live-organic-v3-3ac682146b75 --method live-organic-v3 --out <dir>` with seed 20261111. tables.purpose: Sum of amount_in_usd over swaps with status SUCCESS, by created_day (UTC), NULL USD amounts excluded; same definition as the frozen v3 research snapshot (a day with a SUCCESS swap whose USD is NULL would be null, none are in this window).

tables.name: active_accounts_daily
tables.purpose: value = COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) over the day's transactions; signers_organic = the same after excluding transactions addressed to the Intents verifier and bridge contracts (documented rule in account-sql.ts).

tables.name: transactions_daily
tables.purpose: Every row of the transactions table for the block_date. Successful and failed transactions cannot be told apart (the status column only carries SUCCESS_RECEIPT_ID).

tables.name: contract_usage_daily
tables.purpose: value = FUNCTION_CALL actions per day; active_contracts = distinct receiver accounts of those actions. Receivers with >= 100 calls that day are held individually; the rest are folded into an exact per-day remainder, so both daily totals are exact.

tables.name: contract_usage_top
tables.purpose: Receivers ranked by FUNCTION_CALL actions summed over the window, counting only the days a receiver had >= 100 calls; days_listed is the number of such days.

tables.name: near_price_daily
tables.purpose: The provider's last price sample of the UTC day (close_raw as received, exact string). The free plan has no daily OHLC history, so the day's candle is built from 24 hourly samples (basis hourly_samples_24_per_day).

DECLARE start_date DATE DEFAULT DATE '2026-05-05';
DECLARE end_date DATE DEFAULT DATE '2026-11-12';
SELECT t.block_date AS block_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.signer_account_id) AS distinct_signers
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions` t
WHERE t.block_date >= start_date AND t.block_date < end_date
GROUP BY block_date ORDER BY block_date
